description:
Hushfeed v0.42.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Two ad and Tako surfaces that slipped past the feed filter, both reported on 0.40.0. Ads no longer appear while you scroll a creator's videos from their profile: that pager was asking a separate ad endpoint of its own, which is refused now while Remove feed ads is on. And the "Ask" bar under some videos, which turned out to be one of TikTok's bottom banners rather than a Tako component, is gone with Hide Tako AI on.

Validation: 1419 runtime tests passed locally, plus the patches module suite. The bundle carries 90 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
